rule: golden cases are behaviour tests, never a performance sample

cases.case: first S1 breakout with no prior breakout
cases.expected: BUY at prior 20-day high + tick (open below trigger)
cases.why: T4-S1-ENTRY; filter has no previous breakout
cases.test: GOLDEN confirmed buy (first S1 breakout, no prior breakout)

cases.case: S1 breakout after a losing breakout (2N against first)
cases.why: T4-S1-FILTER: previous breakout was a loser
cases.test: GOLDEN confirmed buy after a losing breakout

cases.case: S1 breakout after a profitable 10-day exit
cases.test: GOLDEN reject: S1 breakout after a winning breakout is skipped

cases.case: skipped S1 breakout that is also a 55-day breakout
cases.test: GOLDEN exception: skipped S1 breakout that is also a 55-day breakout

cases.case: winning hypothetical SHORT breakout followed by a long breakout
cases.expected: long breakout skipped although VU trades long only
cases.test: GOLDEN educational: a short 20-day breakout counts in the S1 filter

cases.case: entry bar whose low is below the 2N stop
cases.expected: stopped on the entry bar (pessimistic declared convention)
cases.why: T4-INTRABAR (daily bars cannot order intrabar events)
cases.test: GOLDEN ambiguous (resolved by the declared convention)

cases.case: trend after entry in 1/2 N steps
entry bar whose low is below the 2N stop
cases.expected: stopped on the entry bar (pessimistic declared convention)
cases.why: T4-INTRABAR (daily bars cannot order intrabar events)
cases.test: GOLDEN ambiguous (resolved by the declared convention)
